mission: UBERBOND MACHIAVELLI Omega-Infinity: THE ABSOLUTE MONEY HUNT (founder directive 2026-10-22). Directive text was not attached to this session or found in the repository: NOT_HYDRATED. The 120 income-mechanism seeds it references are likewise NOT_HYDRATED; nothing here claims to have read them.
selectionRationale: Open drafts #1532/#1535/#1536/#1537/#1538 all work the website-inquiry-audit lane; #1538 already ran E1 there and assigned E2. To avoid duplication, this session runs the two tournament-recommended experiments that were never executed: rank 1 (Single Audit Obligation Radar) and rank 3 (Apify Store breakage). Both are read-only on public data, zero cost, zero contact.

experiments.question: When the radar flags a nonprofit with >= threshold direct federal obligations in a federal fiscal year and no prior FAC filing history, how often does that entity in fact file a Single Audit for that period?
experiments.whyHindcast: Prospective forecasts cannot resolve for ~9-21 months. Federal FY2023 can be resolved now against FAC.

data.fac: keyless FAC bulk CSVs general.csv and additional_ueis.csv from app.fac.gov/dissemination/public-data/gsa/full/ (download date and SHA-256 recorded in the result)
data.usaspending: POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_category/recipient/ ; federal FY2023 (2022-10-01..2023-09-30); award types 02,03,04,05; recipient_type nonprofit; place of performance state

threshold.basis: 2 CFR 200.501 as in force before the 2024 revision; the $1,000,000 threshold applies only to fiscal years beginning on or after 2024-10-01

experiments.estimator: FY2023 direct federal obligations per recipient UEI. Known bias: obligations are not expenditures, and pass-through (subaward) funding is invisible, which harms recall but not the precision measured here.
flagRule: no FAC report (as auditee UEI or as additional UEI) for audit years 2019-2022 accepted before 2023-10-01
no FAC report for audit years 2019-2022 accepted before 2023-10-01 whose normalized auditee name + state equals the recipient's (guards against UEI changes)

outcome.primary: entity files audit year 2023 or 2024 (auditee UEI, additional UEI, or normalized name + state) — absorbs entity fiscal-year misalignment

decisionRules.kill: core-stratum precision_primary < 0.35 (the kill threshold set in docs/MACHIAVELLI_WEALTH_ENGINE.md)
decisionRules.thinYield: median true new obligors per state < 5 means commercially thin even if precise

descriptiveOnly: national first-time filers per audit year (UEI absent from the prior three audit years and from additional_ueis)

experiments.question: Do high-demand public Apify Actors fail often enough, without healthy substitutes, to leave a stranded-user niche a new Actor could serve?
experiments.data: public GET https://api.apify.com/v2/store (no account), full pagination, >= 1 s between calls; only listing fields are retained

definitions.failShare: (FAILED + TIMED-OUT) / TOTAL; ABORTED excluded as user-initiated
definitions.healthySubstitute: different Actor, shares the leader's first category, shares >= 1 title token after stopwords, failShare <= 0.05, runs30 >= 500, users30 >= 50

decisionRules.H2a_kill: fewer than 25 broken leaders: breakage is not a material cross-sectional phenomenon; kill the foundry
decisionRules.H2b_kill: more than 70% of broken leaders already have a healthy substitute with users30 >= 0.5 x the leader's: substitutes already absorb demand; kill the foundry
decisionRules.continue: otherwise, rank unabsorbed broken leaders by stranded users30 as build candidates

experiments.notClaimed: The canon's 14-day migration test needs a second snapshot on or after 2026-11-05 with these exact definitions. One snapshot measures a cross-section, not migration.
